title: Duckling reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- duckling body -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='72' rx='22' ry='16' fill='#FFD93B'/>
  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='76' rx='15' ry='10' fill='#FFE985'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='46' r='14' fill='#FFD93B'/>
  <!-- head highlight -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='42' r='6' fill='#FFE985'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='44' r='2.6' fill='#2A2A4A'/>
  <circle cx='44.8' cy='43.4' r='0.9' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- cheek -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='50' r='2.5' fill='#FF9E5E'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <path d='M52 49 L63 52 L52 55 Z' fill='#FF8A2B'/>
  <path d='M52 52 L62 52.5 L52 55 Z' fill='#F26A1B'/>
  <!-- wing holding book -->
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='66' rx='8' ry='5' transform='rotate(-20 57 66)' fill='#F5C518'/>
  <!-- book left page -->
  <path d='M50 60 L62 58 L62 76 L50 78 Z' fill='#F4F1EA'/>
  <!-- book right page -->
  <path d='M62 58 L76 61 L76 79 L62 76 Z' fill='#E8E3D8'/>
  <!-- book spine -->
  <line x1='62' y1='58' x2='62' y2='76' stroke='#C0392B' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- book cover edges -->
  <path d='M48 60 L50 60 L50 78 L48 79 Z' fill='#C0392B'/>
  <path d='M76 61 L78 62 L78 80 L76 79 Z' fill='#C0392B'/>
  <!-- text lines -->
  <line x1='53' y1='63' x2='59' y2='62' stroke='#8E8E9E' stroke-width='1.4'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='67' x2='59' y2='66' stroke='#8E8E9E' stroke-width='1.4'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='71' x2='59' y2='70' stroke='#8E8E9E' stroke-width='1.4'/>
  <line x1='65' y1='62' x2='73' y2='63' stroke='#8E8E9E' stroke-width='1.4'/>
  <line x1='65' y1='66' x2='73' y2='67' stroke='#8E8E9E' stroke-width='1.4'/>
  <line x1='65' y1='70' x2='73' y2='71' stroke='#8E8E9E' stroke-width='1.4'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='88' rx='7' ry='3' fill='#FF8A2B'/>
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='88' rx='7' ry='3' fill='#FF8A2B'/>
</svg>
